text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 1,080 x 980 x 2 mm. Top face (the wetted face) up in the views.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes along all four edges, 10 mm in from the edge, for the M5

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws up into the wall bottom battens: 5.5 mm. Positions are in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the hole layout picture (plate holes) of the build plan.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three 6.5 mm holes along each east and west edge, 10 mm in, at 90,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 490 and 890 from the south edge: the box to stand bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drain hole 17 mm, 910 from the west edge and 47 from the south edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr all holes. Coat the top face with a food-safe coating after

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the fins are fixed (rivet heads included).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the walls stand on the top face on EPDM gasket tape; the plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge is 10 mm inside the walls' outer faces all round. The stand

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rails run under the east and west edges.

svg.text: Check: flat within 2 mm over its length.
